½ cup salted butter

1 large onion, diced (about 1 1/2 cups)

½ bell pepper, seeded and diced (about 1/2 cup)

4 cloves garlic, minced

1 (10.75-ounce) Red Crab Soup (stock only throw the strained off veg away)

OR 8 ounce seafood stock and 4-5 ounces of tomato sauce or paste.

1 teaspoon salt

3/4 teaspoon ground black pepper OR lemon pepper

1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper

1/2 teaspoon of cayenne.

3 tablespoons cornstarch or tapioca starch mixed with 1/4-cup cold water

2 pounds crawfish tail meat (or the equivalent in total of fish, shrimp, scallops &/or crawfish)

1/2 cup chopped celery

1/3 cup fresh diced parsley or cilantro

2 tablespoons dill

Optional: shaved carrots or green pea.

1 package Ready-Made Pie Crust (2 crusts)

Instructions

1.Preheat oven to 400°.

2.In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat; add onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic; cook until softened.  Add soup/stock, tomato sauce or paste, salt, herbs and peppers. Add corn/tabioca starch mixture. Reduce heat to low, and cook until  thickened, about 5 minutes. Fold in crawfish or seafood combo  and parsley; cook 5 minutes.

3.Place bottom crust in a deep-dish pie plate, and bake, using pie weights, until lightly browned, 7 to 10 minutes. Fill with crawfish mixture, and place top crust on pie. Bake until browned, 25 to 30 minutes.
